law_name: Bangui Agreement (revised 1999), Annex VII on Copyright and Cultural Heritage, applied as national law; national Ordinance No. 85.002 of 5 January 1985 on Copyrights also cited
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (joint works: last survivor + 50); anonymous, pseudonymous, collective and audiovisual works 50 years from publication or making; applied art 25 years
author_rights: Economic rights implied: profit use of folklore needs authorisation and royalty (Ordinance 85.002 Art. 9); no full list of rights in the texts read
fair_use_exceptions: Ordinance 85.002 Ch. II, per Commons summary: non-commercial private or family use and scholarly or religious use (Art. 11); news reporting (Art. 14); public-place art (Art. 15)
enforcement_body: UNKNOWN (Bureau Centrafricain du Droit d'Auteur, BCDA, not confirmed by any result) (unconfirmed)
notes: Berne member since 3 Sep 1977, Bangui Agreement since 8 Feb 1982, WTO since 31 May 1995 (Commons). WCT/WPPT not checked: no list seen. Not verified against primary text.
